prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A row of five modern smartwatches is displayed in a sleek, minimalist setting, each watch standing upright on a dark, reflective wooden surface. The watches are arranged in a gentle arc, receding into the background, with their screens facing forward and slightly angled to the right, creating a sense of depth and perspective. Each watch features a different colored band—ranging from black, brown, and beige to light blue and dark blue—adding subtle variety to the composition.

The watch faces are illuminated, showcasing a range of vibrant, high-contrast digital displays: one shows a stylized lion icon with the text "Power Lion," another displays a progress recap with detailed text, a third features a cheerful sun icon and a motivational morning message, while the last two show abstract glowing star shapes on a black background. The screens are crisp and bright, with white, gold, and orange accents standing out against deep blacks, emphasizing the clarity and modernity of the devices.

The background is a soft, gradient sky blue fading to white, devoid of any distractions, which draws attention to the watches and enhances the clean, futuristic atmosphere. The lighting is even and diffused, with gentle reflections on the watch faces and the polished floor, contributing to a high-end, commercial aesthetic. The overall style is hyper-realistic with a touch of cinematic polish, reminiscent of a luxury tech product advertisement. The camera angle is low and slightly off-center, emphasizing the sleek design and premium materials of the smartwatches, while the shallow depth of field subtly blurs the farthest watch, focusing the viewer’s attention on the central details.
